Most coding agents grep and glob raw source into LLM's context window and hope the model is smart. Benzi compiles your codebase into a queryable map of calls, data flow, control flow and class hierarchy first; then it reads, explains, runs, edits and verifies your code using it. Includes a runtime tracer. 82.4% SWE-bench Verified for < $13.
